"""Restore produced R4 originals only from the actual saved full Git GET bodies."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import stat
import subprocess
import time

HERE=Path('/workspace/scratch/dda74a4fae35/v114-roundtrip-portable-r1')
ROOT=HERE/'handoff-runtime-context-r4'
GET=ROOT/'git-get-restored-leaves'
OUT=ROOT/'git-restored-originals'
def pin(raw):
    return {'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
            'git_blob':hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(raw)).encode()+b'\0'+raw).hexdigest()}
def wire(value):return (json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n').encode()
def read(path):return json.loads(path.read_bytes())
def save(name,value):
    raw=wire(value)
    with (ROOT/name).open('xb') as stream:stream.write(raw)
    return {'name':name,**pin(raw)}
def payload(value):
    result=value['structuredContent']
    return json.loads(result['content']) if type(result.get('content')) is str else result
rows=[]
for name in ('PUBLISH-PLAN-CORE.json','PUBLISH-PLAN-CORE-READBACK.json','PUBLISH-PLAN-CORE-RECIPE.json','PUBLISH-PLAN-RAW.json'):
    rows.extend(read(ROOT/name)['entries'])
assert len(rows)==len({row['name'] for row in rows})==25
GET.mkdir();checked=[]
for row in rows:
    name=row['name'];pub=ROOT/'publication';raw=(ROOT/name).read_bytes()
    post=read(pub/(name+'-blob.response.json'));get=read(pub/(name+'-readback.response.json'))
    receipt=read(pub/(name+'-receipt.json'));intent=read(pub/(name+'-blob.intent.json'))
    assert post.get('isError') is not True and payload(post)['sha']==row['git_blob']
    actual=get['structuredContent']['content'].encode()
    assert get.get('isError') is not True and actual==raw and pin(actual)=={key:row[key] for key in pin(raw)}
    assert intent['args']=={'repository_full_name':'TrillionniumFoundation/Hepta','content':actual.decode(),'encoding':'utf-8'}
    assert receipt=={'status':'ACK_FULL_GET_MATCH',**row}
    with (GET/name).open('xb') as stream:stream.write(actual)
    checked.append({**row,'POST_ACK_sha_verified':True,'full_GET_bytes_verified':True,
        'post_response':pin((pub/(name+'-blob.response.json')).read_bytes()),
        'get_response':pin((pub/(name+'-readback.response.json')).read_bytes()),
        'receipt':pin((pub/(name+'-receipt.json')).read_bytes())})
first=save('RAW-GIT-READBACK.json',{'schema':'hepta.hia.roundtrip-runtime-all-git-readback.v1',
    'status':'ALL_25_ORIGINAL_LEAVES_ACK_FULL_GET_RECOMPUTED','entries':checked,'count':25,
    'transport_errors':[],'all_in_flight_completed':True,'ref_mutation':False,'product_execution':False})
command=['python','-B',str(GET/'restore.py'),str(GET),str(OUT)]
save('RESTORE-INTENT.json',{'command':command,'source':'Actual Git GET bodies only',
    'runtime_used_for_evidence_restore_only':'system Python stdlib; no product imports','product_execution':False})
start=time.monotonic_ns()
with (ROOT/'RESTORE.stdout.log').open('xb') as stdout,(ROOT/'RESTORE.stderr.log').open('xb') as stderr:
    result=subprocess.run(command,stdout=stdout,stderr=stderr,check=False)
save('RESTORE-EXIT.json',{'returncode':result.returncode,'wall_ns':time.monotonic_ns()-start})
assert result.returncode==0
index=read(GET/'RAW-INDEX.json');observed={};directories={}
for path in sorted(OUT.rglob('*')):
    assert not path.is_symlink();info=path.lstat();name=path.relative_to(OUT).as_posix()
    if stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode):directories[name]=stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode);continue
    assert stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode);raw=path.read_bytes()
    observed[name]={**pin(raw),'mode':f'{info.st_mode:06o}'}
    assert raw==(HERE/name).read_bytes(),name
    assert info.st_mode==(HERE/name).stat().st_mode,name
assert observed==index['files'] and directories==index['directories']
assert len(observed)==136 and sum(row['bytes'] for row in observed.values())==4801549 and len(directories)==14
proof={'schema':'hepta.hia.roundtrip-runtime-actual-git-restore.v1','status':'FULL_PRODUCED_RAW_RESTORED_FROM_ACTUAL_GIT_GET',
    'files':len(observed),'directories':len(directories),'logical_bytes':index['logical_bytes'],
    'gzip':index['archive'],'all_original_bytes_modes_SHA_Git_exact':True,
    'command':command,'returncode':result.returncode,'wall_ns':time.monotonic_ns()-start,
    'restore_stdout':(ROOT/'RESTORE.stdout.log').read_text(),'restore_stderr':(ROOT/'RESTORE.stderr.log').read_text(),
    'source_base_self_contained':False,'external_runtime_binaries_not_embedded':True,
    'source_tree':'ecaf40b0a56f2a0a8548b8c6c842374e1b09aac7','product_execution':False,'whole_native':False}
second=save('RESTORE-READBACK.json',proof)
controls=[]
for path in (HERE/'freeze-runtime-raw-r4.stdout.log',HERE/'freeze-runtime-raw-r4.stderr.log',
             HERE/'finalize_runtime_raw_readback_r4.py',ROOT/'RESTORE-INTENT.json',ROOT/'RESTORE-EXIT.json',
             ROOT/'RESTORE.stdout.log',ROOT/'RESTORE.stderr.log'):
    raw=path.read_bytes();controls.append({'path':path.relative_to(HERE).as_posix(),**pin(raw),
        'mode':f'{path.stat().st_mode:06o}','text':raw.decode()})
for path in sorted((ROOT/'publication').glob('raw-batch-*.json')):
    raw=path.read_bytes();controls.append({'path':path.relative_to(HERE).as_posix(),**pin(raw),
        'mode':f'{path.stat().st_mode:06o}','text':raw.decode()})
third=save('POST-ARCHIVE-CONTROLS.json',{'schema':'hepta.hia.roundtrip-runtime-restore-controls.v1',
    'status':'COMPLETE_SMALL_RESTORE_AND_BATCH_ORIGINALS','files':controls,'product_execution':False})
fourth=save('COMPLETE-README.json',{'status':'COMPLETE_R4_SOURCE23_RUNTIME_PROBE_AND_136_PRODUCED_ORIGINALS',
    'source_recipe_core':'1b9544c7db8f409eead924f950ac5447ed49dd7a',
    'Source23':'Actual CPython3.14.4; exact23 IDs/46 events; original22 relative order and original16 file unchanged.',
    'runtime_probe':'Actual qualifier owner after parent LD_LIBRARY_PATH/LD_PRELOAD removal; complete context/owner/child output binding; original180+3 cleanup/ECHILD.',
    'raw_restoration':proof,'earlier_pending_fields':'The small core handoff and RAW-INDEX retain their truthful pre-final-transport status. This final proof records the subsequent complete actual Git restoration; none of those historical files was rewritten.',
    'limits':'No matching-current-cold positive, Native140, VM, portable or whole/default qualification here. Separate checker6 remains5PASS/1FAIL.',
    'external_dependencies':'The exact R3 repository base and original interpreter/library distributions remain explicit external inputs; only produced originals and four source before/after files are claimed restored.',
    'ref_mutation':False})
save('PUBLISH-PLAN-FINAL-CONTROLS.json',{'entries':[first,second,third,fourth]})
print(json.dumps({'status':proof['status'],'files':proof['files'],'logical_bytes':proof['logical_bytes'],
    'directories':proof['directories'],'new_entries':[first,second,third,fourth]}))
